meta.name: appllama-app-design-skill
meta.description: Build native-feeling, benchmark-quality mobile app screens (Expo / React Native). Use when designing or implementing any mobile UI — screens, flows, onboarding, paywalls, tab bars, sheets, settings, empty states — or when polishing motion, navigation, typography, dark mode, or perceived performance. Enforces Apple HIG fidelity, semantic colors, native controls, anti-slop discipline, navigation semantics (push vs replace, modal vs sheet vs overlay, the one-way doors where back must not exist), purposeful Reanimated motion, a full-motion simulator-verified iteration loop, and a study-real-apps-first workflow (pairs with the Appllama MCP). Trigger on "build a screen", "make this screen better", "design the onboarding", "wire up this flow", "polish the UI", "make it feel native", or any mobile design/implementation task.

copy.tagline: 做出接近系统原生的手机 App 界面
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发手机 App,希望界面好看且操作像原生系统一样顺手。
copy.tagline_en: Create mobile app screens with native-level polish and usability.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build mobile apps and care about screens feeling polished and native.

howto.what: Claude 在设计手机 App 界面时,会先参考同类真实 App 的版式,再按系统原生的配色、图标和控件出图,并检查动效、导航和深/浅色显示,让结果像手机上常见的 App,而不是网页模板。
howto.when: 当任务属于手机 App 界面的设计或改进,例如“把这个界面改成原生风格”“设计引导页”“给页面加动效”,即会接管。

say.text: 把这个登录页改成手机系统自带的样式。
say.note: 会按系统控件、配色和深色模式重画。

say.text: 设计一个会员订阅页,观感要像手机原生 App。
say.note: 会先研究类似订阅页,再按系统规范画稿。

say.text: 给这个页面加动效,但别影响流畅顺手。
say.note: 会按原生交互习惯选用克制的动效。

howto.what_en: When designing mobile app screens, Claude studies real apps' patterns first, then uses native colors/icons/controls and checks motion, navigation and light/dark themes—so the output looks native, not like a webpage.
howto.when_en: It activates for any mobile UI design/implementation task, such as "build a screen", "design the onboarding", or making a screen feel native / polishing UI motion.

say_en.text: Restyle this login page with the phone system's native controls.
say_en.note: Redraws it using native controls, colors, and dark mode.

say_en.text: Design a subscription page that feels like a phone-native app.
say_en.note: Studies similar subscription screens first, then follows system design rules.

say_en.text: Add motion to this page without making it feel less fluid.
say_en.note: Chooses restrained, native-style animation and respects reduced-motion settings.
